app.name: SillyTavern Manager
app.tagline: Install, run, back up, and monitor SillyTavern

setup.title: Set up your manager
setup.telemetryNotice: This free software collects limited usage metadata to support the project. It never sends API keys, prompts, chats, model responses, or request logs.
setup.terms: By continuing, you acknowledge the terms and the disclaimer.
setup.disclaimer: You are responsible for your SillyTavern data, credentials, providers, backups, and compliance with applicable service terms.

console.r2Help: Keep an off-machine copy in Cloudflare R2 so a failed disk or deleted workspace does not remove your backup.
console.metadataNotice: Only provider, model, endpoint host, usage totals, status and timing are measured.

page.installationsDescription: Choose a SillyTavern channel and manage its lifecycle.
page.profilesDescription: Keep separate data layouts ready without moving files behind your back.
page.backupsDescription: Local snapshots are always available. Add R2 when you want an off-machine copy.
page.metricsDescription: See provider, model, token and latency trends without storing your conversations.

page.configDescription: Edit common settings with guardrails, or open the raw YAML document.
page.settingsDescription: Control language, appearance, tunnel defaults and privacy notices.
